data.title: Cart total causes a KeyError
story: 🔥 PRODUCTION INCIDENT: Each item in the cart is a dictionary (dict) with "name", "price", and "qty".
The cart_total function always crashes. Run the tests, read the KeyError, then fix it.

explanation: KeyError: 'Price' means that key isn't in the dictionary; the key is written in lowercase, "price". Python treats capital and small letters as different, so key names must match exactly.
hints: Run the tests and read the last line of the error. Which key is it looking for?
Compare the key name in the code with the keys in the item data. Capital and small letters are different!
